Authenticated PAM proof end-to-end: statics -> python3+ctypes libpam login on service greetd -> daemon logs 'Received unlock request' in secrets.log. Transport graveyard diagnosed on live VMs: (1) ssh -L unix forward dead — stock Alpine sshd AllowTcpForwarding no denies ALL local forwards incl. streamlocal + guest.Output CombinedOutput polluted socket path with known_hosts warning; (2) greetd-IPC second start_session dead — greetd 0.10 = ONE session, second session kills autologin c1 -> turnstile tears user dinit down (STOPPD storm) + pam_oo7 delivery thread loses race; (3) FINAL = direct PAM chain over plain exec SSH, autologin + daemon untouched. Second root cause: ctypes RTLD_LOCAL — pam_oo7.so has no DT_NEEDED libpam.so.0 -> musl dlopen fails -> PAM silently skips optional module rc=0; fix mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL (one line). Source-verified 0.6.0: daemon log = tracing::info! (RUST_LOG=info suffices); wire = zvariant D-Bus + u32 LE not JSON; secrets.log = only observable surface; start_daemon fallback = our recovery wrapper (supervision intact). Zero product changes this round. Also: aports CI fix b3970c1 (mirror.gcr.io), oo7-user-dinit r1, installer RUST_LOG=info under enableDebug.
